note: Model data is deliberately NOT in this repo (102 GB). This manifest is the record of what every measurement in results/ was run against.
model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (177B MoE), Q2_0 2.25-bit GGUF, GSQ-RCO quant

shard1.role: native weights (dense + routed experts), passed as --native

shard2.role: PLE n-gram table + tokenizer, passed as --ple-gguf

pack_experts.role: prepared expert set, mmap-streamed from NVMe (24,576 experts)

expert_profile.role: routing-frequency profile that seeds the adaptive expert cache (shipped with the engine)

mtp_draft.role: draft layer downloaded by setup.sh during the measured run, NOT used (--mtp is dropped on this box) and deleted afterwards; listed so a reproduction knows it will be fetched and can be removed

total_disk_footprint.unit_note: gb_decimal = 1e9 bytes, gib = 2^30 bytes; both are given because the write-up used to mix them.
total_disk_footprint.sum_scope: sum of shard1 + shard2 + pack_experts + pack_dense (the model data a run needs). expert_profile ships with the engine and the MTP draft was downloaded but never used, so neither is counted.
total_disk_footprint.measured_on_disk_20261018: 101,893,290,735 bytes = 101.89 GB = 94.90 GiB (the ~9.9 MB difference from 'bytes' above is pack-directory metadata)
total_disk_footprint.excludes: the MTP draft, 6,927,659,014 bytes = 6.93 GB (6.45 GiB): setup.sh downloaded it to Strata-data/mtp, this project never used it (--mtp is dropped on this box), and it was deleted after the measured runs

engine.name: Strata (Niko1221/Strata)
engine.revision_note: Strata/engine/BUILD.json's "src" field is NOT a revision: Strata's setup.py source_hash() stores a 16-hex sha256 fingerprint of the engine sources, used to decide when a git pull needs a rebuild (upstream issue #31). The commit above is the checkout this build came from.
